newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment files for offer.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment files for offer.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said on Friday that it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the proposed public offering of two million shares of common stock to be sold by the company.
Following the offering, there will be about 35,950,000 shares of the company's common stock outstanding.
The company said it will use the proceeds of the offering to repay indebtedness, to fund expansion and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
Montgomery Securities and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation will act as the managing underwriters for the offering.
Hollywood Entertainment Corporation owns and operates 470 video retail superstores in 29 states.
